lead.headline: Onsager Algebras and Lattice Fermions
body: We study the exact Onsager algebra of free lattice fermions in staggered, Wilson, and overlap incarnations, working in both Hamiltonian and Euclidean formulations in four spacetime dimensions. In each case, we show that the exact lattice algebra emanates the full chiral symmetry of the low-energy theory: if there are $N$ massless Dirac fermions in the continuum, the Onsager algebra reduces to a $U(2N)$ chiral symmetry.

The details of which generators are quantised or ultra-local differ between formulations. There is also a trade-off between the locality of generators and the maximum compact subgroup of the Onsager algebra.

features.headline: Quantum gravity on the bulk cone
body: Bulk-cone singularities in holographic correlators encode propagation along bulk null geodesics. The prototypical example is an AdS black hole, where incoming null geodesics can wind around the photon sphere and return to the boundary.

These singularities appear in real time in the thermal two-point function at finite volume. We show that conformal field theories dual to gravitational theories at finite $G_N$ cannot have such singularities.

features.headline: de Sitter Gluon Correlators in Momentum Space
body: We show a new diagrammatic representation of tree-level wavefunction coefficients for gluons in four-dimensional de Sitter space at any multiplicity. Its ``disc diagrams" make the cutting rule manifest, while the remaining contact term is fixed by the absence of folded singularities.
We determine this term for configurations with zero, one and two negative-helicity gluons. It simplifies as more gluons share a helicity, and it vanishes for all-plus.

features.headline: Five-loop static two-body potential in massless scalar-tensor gravity
body: We compute the static contribution to the conservative two-body potential in massless scalar-tensor theories through fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) order, with the strong-field scalar responses of the compact objects encoded in scalar-dependent masses. Within post-Newtonian effective field theory (EFT), evaluating the 1PN-5PN static terms requires one- through five-loop massless two-point Feynman integrals.
Although the additional scalar modifies both source couplings and integrand numerators, the required scalar master topologies remain those of the corresponding static problem in general relativity.

stories.headline: Surface Defects in the $\mathcal{N}=2$ Lens Space Index and Elliptic Integrability
body: We determine the surface-defect difference operators of the 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ lens space index for class $\mathcal{S}$ theories of type $A_{N-1}$ on $(\mathbb{S}^3/\mathbb{Z}_r)\times\mathbb{S}^1$. For generic fugacities $(p,q,t)$ and arbitrary rank $N$, orbifold order $r$ and discrete holonomies, their coefficients are finite products of theta functions with nomes $p^r$ and $q^r$.

stories.headline: Quantum field theory and four-manifolds: Perspectives from physics and geometry
body: These lecture notes are based on lecture series by the authors for the Summer School 2025 on ``Physical mathematics of quantum field theory" at the University of Massachusetts Amherst organized by Owen Gwilliam, Chris Elliott, and Matteo Lotito. The lectures centred around algebraic structures arising from twists of supersymmetric quantum field theories, correlation functions of topologically twisted supersymmetric gauge theories, and their mathematical counterparts as intersection-theoretic invariants associated to moduli spaces of instantons, semistable sheaves, or Higgs sheaves on four-manifolds or complex projective surfaces.

stories.headline: Orientifold and Integrability: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super-Yang-Mills on $\mathbb{RP}^4$
body: We study planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory (SYM) on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^4$ using integrability, holography and supersymmetric localization, and discuss its relation to orientifolds in string theory. We show that the integrability of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM is preserved when combining the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ involution defining $\mathbb{RP}^4$ with the action of the charge conjugation of the SU$(N)$ gauge group.

stories.headline: Higher-Loop Vacuum Integrals on $S^D$
body: We develop a new framework for evaluating higher-loop integrals for scalar fields on $S^D$. Starting from a Schwinger-parametric form for general higher-loop integrals on the sphere, it combines total-derivative identities with edge-contraction relations into a coupled linear system.

stories.headline: Finding CFTs from spatial positivity of partition functions
body: We discuss a positivity property for partition functions that generalizes modular invariance and which is here conjectured to hold for general 2D CFTs. We show its relation to positivity properties of Rényi entropies and its meaning in terms of topological defect lines.

stories.headline: The Spectral Edge at Large Central Charge and Black Hole Statistics
body: We introduce a new approach to high-energy spectra in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, addressing the open challenge of incorporating spectral statistics into the modular bootstrap. Using the analytic theory of $L$-functions attached to two-dimensional CFTs, we leverage modular constraints among high-energy states to derive a sum rule relating the spectral edge to bulk spectral fluctuations.

stories.headline: Beyond the Fock Vacuum in Finite-$N$ Bilocal Algebras of Vector Models
body: We discuss the finite-$N$ Hilbert space of bilocal operators that underlies bilocal holography of vector models, beyond the sector built on the Fock vacuum. If the microscopic oscillator Fock space carries a multiplicity-free dual action of a compact color group $G$ and a bilocal algebra, Howe duality implies that projection to the derived subgroup $[G,G]$ selects precisely the characters of the abelianization $G^{\rm ab}=G/[G,G]$ that occur in the Fock space.

stories.headline: Quasinormal modes, complex null geodesics and singularity resolution in regular AdS black holes
body: The black hole singularity is hidden behind its horizon, and it is difficult to determine whether it is resolved by quantum gravity or stringy effects. For an AdS-Schwarzschild black hole, it is known that the two-point function of the dual conformal field theory has a singularity associated with a null geodesic that bounces off the black hole singularity.

stories.headline: Fermion Hierarchies from Fricke Modular Symmetry
body: We show how Fricke modular symmetry can generate realistic fermion hierarchies and quark CP violation from a single modulus in a supersymmetric effective theory. Matter fields are labelled by the two one-dimensional characters of $Γ_0^+(N)$ that are trivial on $Γ_0(N)$, and interactions use complete spaces of cusp-regular holomorphic modular forms.

stories.headline: Ricci-flat Seeds, Trombone Rescaling and Magnetizing Kerr Black Holes
body: We present a new family of Ricci-flat rotating metrics, which we refer to as Solution II, obtained by demagnetizing the genuine Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (G-KBR) black hole. Together with Solution I, which was previously obtained by demagnetizing the Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) black hole, this gives two families of Ricci-flat deformations of the Kerr black hole, each labeled by $B$.

stories.headline: Cosmological Gravitational Wave Collider Physics
body: Primordial tensor non-Gaussianity can probe massive particles present during inflation. We investigate this possibility in an effective field theory where the massless graviton mixes with the helicity-two mode of an additional massive spin-two field $σ_{ij}$ with cubic self-interactions.

briefs.headline: $N \to Δ$ Transition Form Factors in the Thermal AdS/QCD Soft-Wall Model with Modified Propagators
briefs.text: We investigate electromagnetic (EM) and axial vector (AV) form factors of the nucleon-Delta baryon transition within the thermal AdS/QCD soft-wall model. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Alexander Torsion and Floer Comparisons in the BV-BFV Formalism
briefs.text: We compare relative Abelian BF torsion with the Alexander-graded Euler characteristic of knot Floer homology. (primary category math-ph)

briefs.headline: Timelike Supersymmetric Geometries in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
briefs.text: Seven-dimensional supergravity poses a uniquely intricate supersymmetry problem, combining topologically massive higher-form gauge dynamics, distinct Clifford algebra properties, and rich geometric structures.

briefs.headline: 3D de Sitter from complex Virasoro TQFT: Observers and knots
briefs.text: The Euclidean saddles of 3D Einstein gravity with positive cosmological constant are spherical three-manifolds.

briefs.headline: Scalar-scalar-graviton vertex from Asymptotic Safety
briefs.text: The unitarity and causality properties of asymptotically safe quantum gravity are still unsettled.

briefs.headline: Plabic promotions beyond cluster: quantum cluster structures and the dual canonical basis
briefs.text: Plabic tangles define geometric promotion maps between configurations and, after choosing a lift, between Grassmannians. (primary category math.RT)

briefs.headline: The deepest X-ray view of a kiloparsec scale jet at z=6.1
briefs.text: The mechanism responsible for the high-energy emission observed in kiloparsec-scale jets across cosmic time remains poorly understood. (primary category astro-ph.HE)

briefs.headline: Quark TMDPDFs from Large to Small $x$: A Unified Description of CSS, DGLAP, and Small-$x$ Double Logarithms
briefs.text: We extend the full-kinematic background-field construction developed for gluon transverse-momentum dependent parton distribution functions (TMDPDFs) in Mukherjee et al. [Phys. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: High precision black hole scattering
briefs.text: In this thesis we compute the impulse of a classical black hole scattering encounter in the Post-Minkowskian (PM) expansion - a weak-field expansion in Newton's constant $G$ - up to the fifth order.

briefs.headline: Defect flows from functional relations in the asymptotic semiring
briefs.text: We study perturbations of topological defects by a relevant holomorphic defect field in two-dimensional conformal field theory.

briefs.headline: Extended Local Infrared Cutoff for the Holographic Density
briefs.text: We propose an extended local infrared cutoff for the holographic density that leads to linear cosmological equations and gives exact analytical solutions.

briefs.headline: Quantum Constrained Hamiltonian Descent
briefs.text: We propose Quantum Constrained Hamiltonian Descent (QCHD), a continuous-time quantum framework for optimization under smooth equality constraints. (primary category quant-ph)

briefs.headline: Neutrino Transition Polarizability
briefs.text: We study Neutrino Transition Polarizability, where a light pseudoscalar $φ$ couples active neutrinos to heavy neutral leptons $N$ and interacts with two photons. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Gravitational Waves from New Inflation
briefs.text: Gravitational waves provide one of the most powerful observational probes for discriminating among inflationary models. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Adapted Fröhlich-Pizzo Model for Horizon-Induced Decoherence
briefs.text: The Fröhlich-Pizzo (FP) model is a quantum-mechanical model originally developed to describe the interaction between an atom and the electromagnetic field in the nonrelativistic limit $c\to\infty$. (primary category quant-ph)

briefs.headline: Amplified EFT corrections near exceptional QNMs
briefs.text: We show that the ordinary expansion of EFT corrections to individual QNM frequencies breaks down at an exceptional QNM, and that these corrections become enhanced for near-exceptional QNMs.
briefs.authors: William L. Boyce and Jorge E. Santos

briefs.headline: Collinear Gluons from Gravity: Poincaré-Birkhoff-Witt Decomposition and Twisted Intersections
briefs.text: We give an explicit reconstruction of subleading collinear Yang--Mills amplitudes from one-graviton amplitudes in Einstein--Yang--Mills theory and its string corrections.

briefs.headline: Large $N$ hadron scattering bootstrap: massive pions and glueballs
briefs.text: We extend the large $N$ bootstrap of pion scattering to nonzero pion mass, and apply the same formalism to glueball scattering.

briefs.headline: Exact Two-Loop Effective Potentials in de Sitter Space via Finite-Difference Methods
briefs.text: We compute the renormalised two-loop effective potential of the $O(N)$-symmetric scalar theory on four-dimensional de Sitter space.

briefs.headline: Exact stress-tensor generators distinguish integrable continuations
briefs.text: The same leading $T\bar T$ interaction can coexist with sharply different strong-field responses, even within causal, classically integrable sigma models.

briefs.headline: Inverse KLT kernel of AdS string-amplitude building blocks from the intersection matrix
briefs.text: We develop a topological and combinatorial interpretation of the Kawai--Lewellen--Tye (KLT) relations for $n$-point AdS string-amplitude building blocks, which are disk integrals with multivariable multiple polylogarithm insertions and sphere integrals with their single-valued counterparts.

briefs.headline: A tale of three points: mixed and tensor bispectra beyond leading order in Horndeski gravity
briefs.text: We derive the primordial $\langleζζh\rangle$, $\langleζhh\rangle$, and $\langle hhh\rangle$ bispectra in general Horndeski theory through first order in slow variation, retaining their complete momentum and helicity dependence.
briefs.authors: Y. A. Ageeva and M. A. Stepanov

briefs.headline: From bulk flows to boundary generators and costs
briefs.text: Holographic complexity admits a broad family of bulk observables, yet their relation to boundary state-preparation costs remains unclear.

briefs.headline: Big Crunching Your Big Bang: Doubly Warped Time-Dependent Type II Flux Backgrounds and Scale Separation
briefs.text: We construct three analytic, doubly warped cosmological solutions of massless type IIA supergravity with different choices of fluxes, namely, $H_3$, $\tilde F_2$ and $\tilde F_4$ along internal directions.
briefs.authors: Kazi Fahim Reza Arko et al.

briefs.headline: Twisted scattering from Chern-Simons theory
briefs.text: We consider boundary conditions of two-dimensional Dirac fermions which preserve a non-anomalous continuous symmetry which acts differently on the left- and right-movers.

briefs.headline: Graviphoton mixing with KK modes in the 2D effective theory of charged black holes
briefs.text: We study the effects of massive Kaluza--Klein modes on the two-dimensional low-energy effective theory obtained by the $S^2$ reduction of four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory on a Reissner--Nordström black hole background.

briefs.headline: The Standard Model on a finite bosonic lattice with continuum Weyl fermions
briefs.text: We investigate a formulation of the Standard Model in which gauge and Higgs fields are regulated on a finite lattice, while quarks and leptons remain continuum Weyl fermions.

briefs.headline: Stable and causal frames for BDNK hydrodynamics
briefs.text: We establish the existence of families of linearly stable and causal Bemfica-Disconzi-Noronha-Kovtun (BDNK) frames for arbitrary equation of state and set of physical transport coefficients.

briefs.headline: Circling in on correlation functions in $\mathcal{N}=2$ orbifold theories
briefs.text: We review the harmonic superspace formalism for 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ theories and apply it to orbifolds of $\mathcal N=4$ Super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory.
briefs.authors: Dennis le Plat and Torben Skrzypek

briefs.headline: ${\mathcal{O}}(α_s^2α)$ threshold corrections to inclusive $Z$-boson production
briefs.text: To match the experimental precision targeted by future collider programs, theoretical predictions for Drell-Yan production must incorporate higher-order mixed Quantum Chromodynamics and electroweak corrections. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Hadamard states for linearized gravity on asymptotically flat spacetimes
briefs.text: We consider the quantization of linearized Einstein equations on 4-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes. (primary category math-ph)

briefs.headline: Data analysis of millions of Type IIB flux vacua
briefs.text: We study the vacuum structure of flux compactifications of type IIB string theory on the degree 18 hypersurface in $\mathbb{CP}^4_{1,1,1,6,9}$ with two effective complex structure moduli.

briefs.headline: Non-Geometric Heterotic Vacua from Type II$_0$ Loci
briefs.text: We determine 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ heterotic string backgrounds dual to Type IIB string theory compactified on Calabi--Yau threefolds containing a type II$_0$ locus in their complex structure moduli space.

briefs.headline: Ricci flow of Integrable Sigma Models, Hitchin Systems and Quantum Seiberg-Witten theory
briefs.text: We construct a family of integrable 2d sigma models through 4d Chern-Simons theory and show that their classical point-particle reduction corresponds to a Hitchin system.

briefs.headline: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
briefs.text: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory.

briefs.headline: Holographic surface defect RG flows without supersymmetry
briefs.text: We consider $\mathcal{N}=4$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory with gauge group SU$(N)$, which admits families of conformal surface defects defined by singular boundary conditions for scalar fields that completely break supersymmetry.

briefs.headline: Fluids on null hypersurfaces and Carrollian hydrodynamics
briefs.text: We study intrinsic ideal fluids on null hypersurfaces and their realisations by causal fluids living in the ambient spacetime.

briefs.headline: Reentrant $d=2+1$ Superfluidity at High Temperature
briefs.text: We present a UV-complete model with a global $U(1)$ symmetry in $d=2+1$ dimensions that exhibits a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) ordered phase at arbitrarily high temperatures.
briefs.authors: Subham Dutta Chowdhury and Joan Elias Miro

briefs.headline: A signature of the timelike singularity in holography
briefs.text: In the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence, we provide a simple observable, the imaginary part of the retarded Green's function, which captures the timelike singularity of a charged black brane.

briefs.headline: Fermion-Number Variation for Several Coupling Schemes in an $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ Chiral Soliton Background
briefs.text: When topological solitons are coupled to fermions, they often induce a nontrivial fermion number.

briefs.headline: The 1+1D $\mathcal{N}{=}2$ Wess--Zumino model
briefs.text: We develop the 1+1D $\mathcal{N}{=}2$ Wess--Zumino model with a central extension, starting from Wigner's theorem and the supertranslation group.

briefs.headline: Yukawa textures due to selection rules in magnetized orbifold models
briefs.text: We study systematically Yukawa textures, which can be derived from magnetized $T^2/\mathbf{Z}_2$ and $T^2/\mathbf{Z}_4$ orbifold models with various magnetic fluxes and Scherk-Schwarz phases. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Perturbations and phenomenology of compact objects in quantum gravity theories
briefs.text: This thesis investigates the perturbative dynamics and phenomenology of compact objects in two approaches to quantum gravity: quadratic gravity and asymptotic safety. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Gravitational waves from highly charged binary black holes in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory
briefs.text: We perform fully nonlinear numerical-relativity simulations of electrically charged binary black hole mergers in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton (EMD) theory, varying the magnitude and relative sign of the input charges and the dilaton coupling $a$. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Matter Induced Bounds: Photon Ring, Lyapunov Exponent, Induced Temperature
briefs.text: We investigate analytic bounds on the equatorial photon ring radius and the Lyapunov exponent in rotating black holes containing anisotropic matter. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Localized Neutrinos in Two Dark Dimensions
briefs.text: We study neutrino masses in a six-dimensional framework with two compact dark dimensions. (primary category hep-ph)
briefs.authors: Waqas Ahmed and George K. Leontaris

briefs.headline: ULTRAMAN: A Proposed ultrasound detector for macroscopic dark matter
briefs.text: We propose ULTRAMAN (ULTRAsound Macro ANalyzer), a passive ultrasound array experiment designed to search for macroscopic dark matter (macros) through coherent acoustic disturbances generated as compact objects traverse a controlled target medium. (primary category astro-ph.CO)

briefs.headline: Thermomagnetic enhancement of conserved-charge correlations in a lattice-constrained PNJL model
briefs.text: Conserved-charge correlations offer a promising probe of magnetic fields in strongly interacting matter. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Mass-Varying Dark Matter, Naturally
briefs.text: Ultralight scalars that vary dark-matter masses require protection from quantum corrections. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Phonon-assisted free-electron recoil control and mechanical sensing
briefs.text: Mechanical vibrations are fundamental to a wide range of physical phenomena and technologies, yet their ability to actively shape free-electron dynamics remains largely unexplored. (primary category physics.optics)

briefs.headline: AnyonWiki.org
briefs.text: The AnyonWiki is an open-source project that provides full algebraic and numerical data of fusion and unitary modular fusion categories as a resource for the scientific community. (primary category math.QA)

briefs.headline: Inaccessibility of the Cosmological Singularity to Quantum Probes
briefs.text: We propose an operational resolution of the FLRW big bang singularity using quantum probes satisfying a curvature coupled Klein-Gordon equation. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Hydrodynamic description of correlation matrix eigenvalues in a finite temperature expanding free fermionic gas
briefs.text: A recent work considered the Page curve for entanglement entropy of a freely expanding one-dimensional Fermi gas starting from a finite box (the system) in a zero-temperature initial state that then expands in to a semi-infinite vacuum (the environment). (primary category quant-ph)

briefs.headline: Generalized Coordinate Bethe Ansatz and Quantum Integrability of the Time-Dependent Massive Thirring Model
briefs.text: We develop a generalized coordinate Bethe-ansatz framework for the massive Thirring model with an explicitly time-dependent fermion mass. (primary category math-ph)

briefs.headline: Local tests of Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson spacetime
briefs.text: We study weak field local tests of Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson spacetime, which describes a static black hole embedded in an external magnetic field. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Semiclassical effects on ultramassive spacetimes
briefs.text: A recent work [Senovilla, Port. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Quantum Charge as a Particle/Antiparticle Label
briefs.text: We show that the concept of particles and antiparticles is related to the Weyl-Heisenberg group $W\!H_3$. (primary category math-ph)

briefs.headline: Mellin Moments of Proton Unpolarized GPDs at Nonzero Skewness from Lattice QCD with a Neural-Network Parametrization
briefs.text: We use lattice QCD to determine the generalized form factors (GFFs) entering the first four Mellin moments of the unpolarized isovector $u-d$ proton GPDs at nonzero skewness. (primary category hep-lat)

briefs.headline: New CP-violating sources beyond the reach of EDMs
briefs.text: The Standard Model does not contain sufficient amount of CP violation to account for the observed baryon asymmetry of the universe. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Interacting quantum reference frames
briefs.text: We formulate quantum reference frames within the Dirac quantization of gauge theories, where physical states are obtained from a kinematical Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_{\rm kin}$ by group averaging. (primary category quant-ph)
briefs.authors: Leonardo Chataignier and Alexander R. H. Smith

briefs.headline: Krylov Complexity and Entropy of Composite Quantum Systems
briefs.text: We investigate the behaviour of Krylov complexity as the number of degrees of freedom of a quantum system increases.

briefs.headline: De Sitter Observers and an Effective Field Theory of Horizon Edge Modes
briefs.text: We show that choosing a test observer in $dS_D$, specified by the framed embedding of their horizon $S^{D-2}$, spontaneously breaks the de Sitter and internal sphere isometries to diagonal rotations.

briefs.headline: Half-Completeness from Standard Gravitational Dispersion Relations
briefs.text: The completeness hypothesis states that quantum gravity realizes every representation allowed by its gauge group.

briefs.headline: The classical two-loop amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy for graviton emission in multi-Regge kinematics
briefs.text: Using the gravitational shockwave formalism, we compute the classical part of the $\mathcal{O}(G^{7/2})$ five-point amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy describing the emission of a graviton in the collision of two massless scalars in multi-Regge kinematics (MRK).

briefs.headline: Phases of flux vacua and their quantum symmetries
briefs.text: We present a torsional linear sigma model with (0,2) supersymmetry that realizes, in its large radius phase, a five-dimensional heterotic flux vacuum, and we use the linear sigma model to connect this geometry to a stringy regime realized as an asymmetric orbifold of a Gepner model and a circle.

briefs.headline: A periodic $\bar q$ equation for form factors
briefs.text: MHV form factors of the chiral stress-tensor multiplet in planar $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory are dual to periodic null Wilson loops.

briefs.headline: Normal Matrix Model and Hyperelliptic Curves
briefs.text: We present a two-matrix model with a normal matrix with eigenvalues confined to contours in the upper half plane coupled to a Hermitian matrix.

briefs.headline: The Stringy Photon Sphere
briefs.text: The S matrix on an asymptotically-flat Schwarzschild black hole is studied as a function of position on $\mathcal{I}$.

briefs.headline: Maxwell-Chern-Simons-Matter in AdS$_3$
briefs.text: We study Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory on AdS$_3$ coupled to $N$ complex scalars or Dirac fermions, including sextic and Gross-Neveu interactions, respectively.

briefs.headline: Carrollian Symmetries and Dynamical Entropy
briefs.text: Carrollian geometry has recently emerged as the proper language to understand the geometry of null hypersurfaces from an intrinsic perspective.

briefs.headline: 8-type electric flux tube solutions in SU(3) gauge theory
briefs.text: We consider electric flux tube solutions in SU(3) gauge theory with scalar fields in the fundamental representation, for an electric field in the $λ_8$ direction (8-type).

briefs.headline: Scale Anomaly in Supersymmetric Quantum Electrodynamics: Ward Identities, Supersymmetry Breaking, and Decoupling
briefs.text: We study the breaking of the scale symmetry both within classical and quantum frameworks in the supersymmetric quantum electrodynamics (SQED) by applying a four-dimensional regularization that preserves supersymmetry.
briefs.authors: A. Yu. Petrov and A. R. Vieira

briefs.headline: Can componentwise D7-tadpole cancellation yield a chiral Standard Model? A no-go for smooth O7$^{-}$ orientifolds
briefs.text: We study a componentwise prescription for D7-tadpole cancellation that includes, as a special case, the local cancellation used in several moduli-stabilisation constructions.

briefs.headline: Constrain the number of inner horizons from gravitational Noether charges
briefs.text: A central question in the study of black hole interiors is how matter and geometry constrain the number of horizons. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Spin-Clifford Bundles and Spin Connections on the Hyperbolic Clifford Algebra - Part I
briefs.text: We develop the theory of spinor fields associated with the hyperbolic Clifford algebra $\mathbb{R}^{H}=\mathcal{C}\ell(H_V)$, which is associated with hyperbolic space $H_V=V\oplus V^{*}$. (primary category math-ph)
briefs.authors: E. Notte-Cuello and J. M. Hoff da Silva

briefs.headline: $B_{sJ}(6114)$ as a Higher-Partial-Wave $\bar{K}^{*}B^{(*)}$ Molecular Candidate
briefs.text: In 2021, the LHCb Collaboration observed the $B_{sJ}(6114)$ state in the $B^\pm K^\mp$ invariant mass spectrum. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: Unitarity methods for Magnus amplitudes
briefs.text: Magnus amplitudes refer to the matrix elements of the logarithm of the $S$-matrix.

briefs.headline: On Born-Infeld-type higher-spin interactions and supersymmetry
briefs.text: We develop a simple Lorentz-covariant construction of the Born--Infeld-type cubic interactions $(s, s_1, s_2)$ of massless higher-spin fields with $s + s_1 + s_2$ derivatives in four-dimensiona flat space.

briefs.headline: Small black hole in de Sitter as an observer
briefs.text: We study the Euclidean path integral around magnetically charged lukewarm black holes in four-dimensional de Sitter space.

briefs.headline: TQFT gravity dual to the orbifold groupoid of Narain code CFTs over $\mathbb{Z}_4$
briefs.text: In a companion paper arXiv:2610.26610, we classified the Narain conformal field theories obtained by gluing copies of the $A_3$ root and weight lattices along their $\mathbb{Z}_4$ discriminant group.

briefs.headline: Pressure in Wilsonian effective field theory
briefs.text: We study the exponential rolling tachyon solution in Wilsonian effective field theory as a model for rolling tachyons in open string field theory.
briefs.authors: Vinícius Bernardes and Atakan Hilmi Fırat

briefs.headline: Random Euclidean CFT$_2$ from Triangulated dS$_3$ Gravity
briefs.text: We propose a random Euclidean CFT description of three-dimensional de Sitter gravity, with fixed central charge and primary spectrum but fluctuating operator product coefficients.

briefs.headline: Twisted Correlators from Harmonic Superspace
briefs.text: We establish a harmonic superspace formulation for $\mathcal N=2$ orbifolds of $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory.
briefs.authors: Dennis le Plat and Torben Skrzypek

briefs.headline: Quasinormal-mode stability bounds in gravitational EFT: resolvability, predictivity, and positivity
briefs.text: It has been proposed that consistency limits how slowly black holes can ring down in extensions of General Relativity: effective-field-theory (EFT) corrections may lengthen the decay time of a quasinormal mode by at most about one oscillation period, $\Re[ω_{\rm GR}]\,δτ\lesssim1$.

briefs.headline: Charmed baryon-to-meson ratios inside jets as a discriminator of hadronization mechanisms: from color reconnection in p+p to coalescence in Pb+Pb
briefs.text: Jets separate the products of hard scatterings from the underlying event and thus help to clarify the origin of the enhanced baryon-to-meson ratios observed from small to large collision systems. (primary category hep-ph)

briefs.headline: String Amplitudes on Integer Rectangles
briefs.text: Hidden zeros of tree-level string amplitudes of colored scalars lie on loci specified by integer-valued dimensionless momentum contractions arranged in rectangles on the kinematic mesh.

briefs.headline: "Massive" Conformal Field Theories and application to Nambu-Goto string
briefs.text: I describe the recent progress in understanding diffeomorphism invariant two-dimensional theories with dimensionful parameters which have nevertheless traceless improved energy-momentum tensor and turn out to be conformal invariant.
